items.title: Hormel Foods (HRL) Just Gave Investors Something To Think About
items.summary: Dividend increase puts Hormel Foods on income investor radar Hormel Foods (HRL) has raised its quarterly dividend to US$0.2950 per share, payable on February 16, 2027. This move highlights management’s stance on returning cash to shareholders. The ex dividend and record dates are both set for January 11, 2027, which is when investors need to be on the books to receive the payout.
